senses.gloss: , (cmp. Assyr. kidînu servant, Friedr. Del. Proleg. p. 200 note 7) [to bend,] to yoke, put to work.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:24">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:10">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ</cite> (<he>בריחיים</he>) <he>כּוֹדְנוֹ לריחיים</he> he puts his father to treading the mill (Bab.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:3:7">Y. Pes. IV, 31ᵃ</cite> top <he>לכשיזקין הוא כודנו בריחיים</he> when the horse grows old, he puts him &c.

Lam. R. to I, 14 (ref. to נפש חיה, Gen. II, 7, as if meaning self-supporting) עשאו עבד מ׳ בפני עצמו וכ׳ the Lord made man a slave put to work for himself, for if he does not work, he has nothing to eat; Gen. R. s. 14 מכורן, מחורר; Koh. R. to II, 17 מכורן עבד (corr. acc.).—Pl. fem. מְכוּדָּנוֹת.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> (play on <he>יְשִׂפַּח</he>, <cite ref="Isaiah 3:17">Is. III, 17</cite>) <he>עשאן שְׁפָחוֹת מכ׳</he> the enemies made them handmaids, forced to hard labor; <cite ref="Isaiah 3:17">ib.</cite> <he>מהו מ׳ אמהן משעבדן</he>; <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 4:18">Lam. R. to IV, 15</cite> <he>מכודניות</he> (corr. acc.).—V. <cite ref="K00203"><he>כּוּדְנָא</he></cite>.
